title: A Ghost of a Chance (C major)

details.title: A Ghost of a Chance
details.lead: Victor Young, 1932, words by Bing Crosby and Ned Washington. The chorus as it is written, with the return to the sign and the coda in their place, in C major: concert D4 to E5. Each A repeats G, steps up to B♭ and slides back by half steps through A and A♭, then rises to D and falls to E or C; the middle part climbs in triplets to A, B♭ and C. Slow, about 80 a minute.
